content.title: eBay Down Today: Thousands Report Search Not Working Amid Major Outage
content.text: eBay Down: On Monday, thousands of eBay users complained about the failure of the search feature in the platform, as it does not allow the shopper to search through the listings. The connection problems had impacted the eBay site as well as the mobile application causing a lot of panic amongst both buyers and sellers. eBay Service Disruption Breakdown As per Down Detector, a web-based outage monitoring site, more than 4,300 users had already bingoed issues by 1:07 PM EST. Out of these 59% reported that the search feature did not work at all, 23% had problems with mobile applications and 17% had problems with the websites. The number of reports started to increase dramatically after 11:00 AM PT, when about 2,700 users reported problems. What Impact Does the Outage Have on Users? The failure caused frustration to many users especially those one who is trying to conduct time-sensitive transactions or auctions. Social media was used to highlight the challenge faced by users in finding their activities and making purchases and some of the sellers complained that they might lose revenue due to the downturn. You Might Be Interested In What Caused eBay & its Response To date, eBay has not announced the reason why the disruption occurred. The status page of the company shows that the services of the company are available, however, it recognizes that it monitors user reports and updates status every 30 minutes. According to analysts, such outages are normally due to server congestions, bugs within the software or the maintenance mistakes. How Is eBay Monitoring the Issue & Working Toward a Resolution? eBay is also monitoring user reviews on its application and webpage. The platform gathers the outages data of third-party monitoring websites, such as Down Detector. The root cause of the malfunctioning of the search function is under investigation by engineers. Status updates are being updated in real time to ensure users are updated on current developments. The technical crew of eBay is putting remedies to put the company into full functionality as soon as it can. When it has been resolved, internal monitoring tools are applied to maintain the stability of apps and websites. Open communication channels are maintained to the users to update on the communication and the projected timelines of resolution. Disclaimer: Information is based on user reports and tracking services; eBay status may change as company updates its platform and resolves the issue.
